purpose: Test where the retained mechanisms can contribute, rather than claiming every module helps every query or setting.
strata_definition: Frozen published a100_language_scope_audit.classify and expression_types, based only on task-query text; overlapping groups, not manual labels or observed errors.
GT_barrier: Analyze each existing study only after its own full raw/count seal, official evaluations and analysis.json; no new predictions, GT match or teacher/head training.
comparisons: All already registered contrasts in the respective study, within the same query subset; no promotion of a subgroup-best arm.
statistic: Unmodified vendor HOTA.combine_sequences over subset queries, never average query HOTA. Exact local subset sufficient arrays and full precision; public overview rounded and explicitly display-only.
interpretation: Development-data point estimates and seed sensitivity, no subgroup population CIs, no cherry-picked acceptance or global dominance claim; KITTI only4 original videos.
